## Synopsis

Takes the role away from the user by deleting their assignment of it. A role
the user reaches through another role is not held directly and goes with that
role. A membership the identity manager wrote is mastered there, so remove it
there as well.

```
strazactl unassign <role> [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --user string   username to take the role away from
```

## Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --server string   strazad base URL (overrides $STRAZA_SERVER and the server you logged into)
```
